lines.zh: 八条腿依次抬起，沙上留下一串孔。
lines.en: Eight legs lift in turn, dotting the sand.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴翘在背上，钩子朝前。
lines.en: My tail rides high, stinger forward.

lines.zh: 我横着走，影子像一把钳子。
lines.en: I move sideways; my shadow looks like pincers.

lines.zh: 沙粒被我的外壳刮得沙沙响。
沙脊上，我一级一级往上爬。
lines.en: Up the sand ridge, stone by stone.

lines.zh: 背上有小蝎子抓着我的甲。
lines.en: Small scorpions cling to my back.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，八条腿压得沙下沉。
lines.en: Slow going; eight legs press the sand down.
My sting draws a line in the air.

lines.zh: 沙子底下有细响，我停住。
lines.en: Something whispers under the sand; I halt.
The sound shifts and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我把两只钳子朝前撑开。
沙面留下八行浅浅的孔。
lines.en: Eight rows of small holes follow me.
The moon turns the sand grey.
I lie still on the sand.

lines.zh: 风把我的尾尖吹得轻轻抖。
lines.en: Wind makes my tail tip quiver.
I feel the air with them.

lines.zh: 有人从很远的地方走过。

lines.en: The small ones on my back are asleep.

lines.zh: 一整天，我连尾尖都没抬。
lines.en: All day I haven't lifted even my tail tip.
I raise my head, pincers toward you.

lines.zh: 你的脚，正压着我的影子。
lines.en: Your feet are standing on my shadow.

lines.zh: 尾巴贴着背，钩子收在肩后。
lines.en: Tail flat to my back, stinger tucked low.
You step back half a pace, scattering sand.

lines.zh: 我的钳尖，离你更近了一寸。
lines.en: My pincer tip is an inch closer now.

lines.zh: 我每一步，都碾得沙粒作响。
lines.en: Every step grinds the sand aloud.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一臂，谁都不动。
lines.en: An arm's length apart, neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 背甲上那道白痕，又深了。
lines.en: The pale crack on my back runs deeper.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，腿乱了一下。
lines.en: I give half a step; my legs scramble.

lines.zh: 壳下挤出一声短促的摩擦。
lines.en: A short rasp escapes from under my shell.
My blood is on the sand.

lines.zh: 腿一根根找回沙里的支点。
lines.en: One by one my legs find purchase in the sand.

lines.zh: 甲上这道口子，换我一步不退。
lines.en: This crack costs me nothing; I hold my ground.
You set it on the sand.

lines.zh: 没味道的东西，我懒得看。
lines.en: I don't bother with things that have no scent.
My trail remains in the sand.

lines.zh: 背上的小蝎子叫了一声。
lines.en: A small one on my back squeaks.
I shield them with my tail.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我照旧往前。
lines.en: Bump over, I go on as before.
When the sand cools at night.

lines.zh: 两只钳子轻叩，像在商量。
lines.en: Two pincers tap, as if bargaining.
She stops at a rock crack.
We enter one after the other.

lines.zh: 小蝎子会抓在我的背上。
lines.en: The small ones will cling to my back.

lines.zh: 钳口一合，壳上留下白印。
lines.en: My pincers close and leave a pale mark.
It is harder than my head.
I turn it, looking for a seam.

lines.zh: 翻了两圈，连条缝都没有。
lines.en: Turned it twice; not a single seam.
I scoop out what is inside.
I drop the shell on the sand.

lines.zh: 八条腿一齐转向那声音。
lines.en: All eight legs turn toward the sound.

lines.zh: 它踩着沙，完全没往这边看。
lines.en: It walks the sand, never glancing this way.

lines.zh: 我不动，等它先迈那一步。
lines.en: I stay still and let it take the first step.

lines.zh: 等它看见钩子，已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time it sees the stinger, it's late.

lines.zh: 我在它外围，一圈圈收紧。
lines.en: Around it, I draw the circle tighter.
It goes left; I cut it off.
It goes right; I am there too.
I am faster than it thought.
My tail comes down from above.

lines.zh: 毒钩一落，它连跳带滚地跑了。
lines.en: My stinger falls; it scrambles away.

lines.zh: 第二下，我夹的是它的手腕。
lines.en: The second clamp takes its wrist.
I bring the other pincer in.
A small mound rises in the sand.
I shake the sand off my back and settle.
I turn my pincers that way.

lines.zh: 火苗舔过甲缝，壳开始发脆。
lines.en: Flames lick my seams and my shell turns brittle.

lines.zh: 我从石上摔下去，甲磕裂了。
lines.en: I fall from a stone and my shell cracks.
Water enters my seams; I claw upward.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，腿都张开了。
lines.en: The blast flips me, legs splayed.
Hungry so long my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我的钩子发亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sand; my stinger glows.

lines.zh: 没有沙，我的腿找不到着力点。
lines.en: No sand; my legs find no purchase.
